review.algorithm_assessment: Aggregate planets with equal period after rotating by their present time. Periods13,17,19,23 are coprime to all remaining allowed periods<=24, and cannot have multiples in that range; CRT lets their independent maxima coexist. All other periods divide55440, so enumerate their exact joint cycle and add the independent maxima. Handles repeated periods and multi-dataset zero sentinel.
